# plot_csds { #mofography.visualize.plot_csds }

`visualize.plot_csds(rag, pbc_groups, cscale=None, no_pbc=False, cluster_key='cluster')`

> This function takes in a RAG and a list of PBC groups and plots cavity size distributions (CSD) for each PBC group. 

Let's see how it works:

## Parameters

| Name         | Type   | Description                                                                | Default    |
|--------------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `rag`        |        | the region adjacency graph                                                 | _required_ |
| `pbc_groups` |        | a list of sets of nodes that are connected by periodic boundary conditions | _required_ |

## Returns

| Type   | Description            |
|--------|------------------------|
|        | A plotly figure object |

## Deprecated alias

`plot_psds` warns and calls `plot_csds`.
